{"people":[{"name":"Elena","role":"account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"},{"name":"Stefan","role":"new head of payments at Kestrel Learning","side":"customer"},{"name":"CFO (unnamed)","role":"CFO at Kestrel Learning, approved the decision","side":"customer"},{"name":"engineering manager (unnamed)","role":"former owner of payments, original buyer of Stripe, left last year","side":"customer"},{"name":"payments performance team","role":"Stripe team that produced the market-by-market analysis","side":"us"},{"name":"Adyen","role":"competitor that ran a test on international traffic","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Adyen"],
"incumbent":"Stripe (us), on a contract up for renewal",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"A new head of payments. Stefan. They'd never had one.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Trigger: a new role and a new buyer with no prior relationship with us."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"Payments sat under an engineering manager, the guy who originally bought us, and he left last year.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","decider"],"note":"Our original champion left a year earlier; ownership of the account changed."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"Stefan came from a much bigger company, and the first thing he did was pull declines by country.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"The evaluation started from the customer's own decline analysis by country."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"A few of their international markets looked bad to him.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Secondhand: the problem was framed as international performance."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"I don't know exactly. He mentioned Brazil and a couple in Europe. I never saw his analysis.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","gaps"],"note":"The rep never saw the customer's data. The markets are named only vaguely."},
{"id":"E6","turn":6,"excerpt":"Stefan recommended it and the CFO approved.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Two deciders: Stefan recommends, the CFO approves. The rep is relaying what Stefan told her."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"this went to the CFO two weeks ago.","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Combined with T8, the decision went to the CFO before the rep's last call."},
{"id":"E8","turn":8,"excerpt":"Yeah.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Confirms the CFO approval came two weeks before the rep's final call."},
{"id":"E9","turn":10,"excerpt":"Adyen ran a test on a slice of their international traffic and came back with results by country.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Reported by the customer: the competitor showed proof using the customer's own traffic, by country."},
{"id":"E10","turn":10,"excerpt":"local acquiring.","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"The customer's repeated phrase for what the competitor offered."},
{"id":"E11","turn":10,"excerpt":"I can't tell you what the test showed. He wouldn't share it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"We have no visibility into the competitor's results."},
{"id":"E12","turn":12,"excerpt":"They got very specific. What's our approval rate in this country, on this card type, by issuer. And why.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps","language"],"note":"After the competitor test, the customer's questions shifted to granular per-market data."},
{"id":"E13","turn":14,"excerpt":"The Authorization Boost deck. The average uplift customers see. Adaptive Acceptance, the machine learning piece.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"We answered with a generic deck and averages, not the customer's own data."},
{"id":"E14","turn":14,"excerpt":"that's an average. What's mine?","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language","gaps"],"note":"Direct rejection of our averaged uplift claim."},
{"id":"E15","turn":14,"excerpt":"I can't take an average to my CFO.","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decider"],"note":"The CFO audience needed customer-specific numbers."},
{"id":"E16","turn":16,"excerpt":"It's a renewal, so we weren't really pitching.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Deflects the pitch question and conflicts with presenting the Authorization Boost deck."},
{"id":"E17","turn":16,"excerpt":"They like the product. The developers love us, billing works, nobody wanted to rip anything out.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"The rep's read of retained goodwill. No customer source is given."},
{"id":"E18","turn":16,"excerpt":"That's why the US stayed.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"The US business stayed with us (partial retention). The cause is the rep's theory."},
{"id":"E19","turn":16,"excerpt":"Silence was the uplift number, like I said.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The uplift number got no traction."},
{"id":"E20","turn":16,"excerpt":"I offered a roadmap session and he didn't take it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Our roadmap offer was declined."},
{"id":"E21","turn":18,"excerpt":"I don't think there was a moment. It was kind of decided before we got in the room. I'm not sure there was anything to do.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Says there was no moment. Later turns show missed signals and fixable findings."},
{"id":"E22","turn":20,"excerpt":"When the renewal notice went out and Stefan replied asking to split the contract.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"We only learned of the evaluation at renewal, when the customer asked to split the contract."},
{"id":"E23","turn":22,"excerpt":"Before I took the account. So nine months? Ten.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"No business review for roughly 9-10 months before renewal."},
{"id":"E24","turn":22,"excerpt":"It was a healthy account. Growing, no tickets. It wasn't on anybody's list.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Health was judged by tickets and growth, which missed the decline-rate concern."},
{"id":"E25","turn":24,"excerpt":"No. I knew the engineering manager had left. I didn't know they'd hired a head of payments.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","gaps"],"note":"We missed the new decision-maker's arrival entirely."},
{"id":"E26","turn":26,"excerpt":"A market-by-market view of their own approval rates, with reasons.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"The core ask we couldn't show in time."},
{"id":"E27","turn":26,"excerpt":"But that landed three weeks after he asked, and by then the test was finished.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Our analysis arrived too late, after the competitor test was finished."},
{"id":"E28","turn":26,"excerpt":"He asked who at Stripe looks at his numbers every month, and I didn't have a name.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Second gap: no named person owning ongoing payments performance."},
{"id":"E29","turn":28,"excerpt":"Real findings. Things we could have fixed.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Conflicts with 'not sure there was anything to do.'"},
{"id":"E30","turn":28,"excerpt":"He said it was the most useful thing we'd sent him.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["message","gaps"],"note":"Paraphrased customer praise for the analysis. It shows what would have worked."},
{"id":"E31","turn":30,"excerpt":"Money left on the table.","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"The customer's headline framing of the problem."},
{"id":"E32","turn":30,"excerpt":"Local cards, local rails.","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","competitor"],"note":"The customer's framing of the solution, aligned with the competitor."},
{"id":"E33","turn":30,"excerpt":"He doesn't say \"authorization,\" he says \"approvals.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Vocabulary mismatch with our 'Authorization Boost' naming."},
{"id":"E34","turn":30,"excerpt":"I heard from Stripe when I said I was leaving.","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided","language"],"note":"Customer felt ignored until churn; we engaged only reactively."},
{"id":"E35","turn":32,"excerpt":"They went with local acquiring.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","competitor"],"note":"The international business moved to the competitor's local acquiring."},
{"id":"E36","turn":32,"excerpt":"I don't know what I'd have pitched against that.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"No counter-positioning against local acquiring."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E21","E29"],"what":"Rep says 'not sure there was anything to do' but later says the analysis had 'things we could have fixed.'"},
{"evidence":["E21","E23","E25","E27","E28","E34"],"what":"Rep says there was no moment, yet describes concrete misses: no review for 9-10 months, an unknown new head of payments, an analysis three weeks late, no named owner, and contact only at churn."},
{"evidence":["E16","E13"],"what":"Says 'we weren't really pitching' but describes presenting the Authorization Boost deck and the average uplift."},
{"evidence":["E24","E3","E4"],"what":"Calls it a healthy account on nobody's list, while the customer saw bad decline rates in international markets."},
{"evidence":["E21","E30"],"what":"'Decided before we got in the room', yet the customer called our late analysis the most useful thing we'd sent, suggesting it could have mattered earlier."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"Which ones? (which international markets)","turn":4,"what":"Vague answer: 'Brazil and a couple in Europe'. The rep never saw the analysis."},
{"question":"Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?","turn":16,"what":"Deflected with 'it's a renewal, so we weren't really pitching' and pivoted to product goodwill."},
{"question":"When did you first feel this was lost? What happened right before?","turn":18,"what":"Answered 'no moment' and 'nothing to do', then contradicted this in T20-T30."},
{"question":"Anything else?","turn":32,"what":"States the outcome but offers no reflection on how to compete beyond 'I don't know what I'd have pitched.'"}
],
"skipped":["decided"],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"approvals","ours":"authorization (Authorization Boost)","evidence":["E33","E13"]},
{"theirs":"what's mine","ours":"the average uplift customers see","evidence":["E14","E13"]},
{"theirs":"Money left on the table","ours":"uplift","evidence":["E31","E13"]},
{"theirs":"Local cards, local rails / local acquiring","ours":"Adaptive Acceptance, the machine learning piece","evidence":["E32","E10","E13"]},
{"theirs":"who at Stripe looks at his numbers every month","ours":"roadmap session","evidence":["E28","E20"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E22"],"what":"The customer asked to split the contract at renewal."},
{"evidence":["E18"],"what":"The US business stayed with us: partial retention."},
{"evidence":["E35","E9"],"what":"The international business moved to Adyen's local acquiring: a partial loss to a competitor."},
{"evidence":["E6","E7","E8"],"what":"Stefan recommended and the CFO approved the move about two weeks before the rep's last call."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep says 'not sure there was anything to do' but later says the analysis had 'things we could have fixed.'
Rep says there was no moment, yet describes concrete misses: no review for 9-10 months, an unknown new head of payments, an analysis three weeks late, no named owner, and contact only at churn.
Says 'we weren't really pitching' but describes presenting the Authorization Boost deck and the average uplift.
Calls it a healthy account on nobody's list, while the customer saw bad decline rates in international markets.
'Decided before we got in the room', yet the customer called our late analysis the most useful thing we'd sent, suggesting it could have mattered earlier.
